title: Recently discovered 10,000-year-old ancient city in Texas

tellings.quote: There's a there's a there's an ancient city in Texas that was discovered recently that's 10,000 years old next to this river.

plain: An ancient city about 10,000 years old was recently discovered in Texas next to a river, according to a researcher named Luke Caverns. He mentions it on the show without naming the place or a source. If true, it would mean people built cities in North America far earlier than usually thought.
